unit_conversion.rule: All EPS-source numeric values (font_size, positions) are in EPS userspace units. Convert to PDF points via formula below.

esko_spot_colors_omitted.Face-Cut: White acrylic substrate per Jerry 90253 reference — no face paint separation needed.

bbox._coord_system: y-down from face top-left; ready for SVG/PDF y-up flip by renderer

overlay_spot_color.rule: Renderer MUST overlay this text in the /Text named spot color from the base PDF's ColorSpace dict. Do NOT use /White or any other spot.
Renderer MUST overlay translated braille glyphs in the /Braille named spot color from the base PDF. Do NOT use /White or any other spot.

braille_translation.rule: Renderer can use either path. Path A (recommended): write ascii_braille_for_placeholder literally through the California Braille font. Path B: translate source_text on the renderer side using the Grade 2 numeric pattern (number indicator '#' + dropped-letter digits, a=1...j=0).

do_not_use.rendering_literal_digits_as_braille_font: Writing '(423)' literally through California Braille font does NOT produce valid Grade 2 braille. Variable digits MUST be pre-translated to ASCII Braille (number indicator + dropped letters) before rendering through the font.
do_not_use.unicode_braille_codepoints: California Braille is a SHAPE FONT that maps ASCII characters to braille glyph shapes. It does NOT render Unicode braille codepoints (U+2800-U+28FF). Passing Unicode strings to the font produces wrong output.
